# PKI use cases

Every X.509 certificate this service relies on is validated for one of these use cases. See [Certificate validation](pki.md#certificate-validation-what-is-checked-and-where) for what each check means and [Paranoid PKI mode](pki.md#paranoid-pki-mode) for when they apply. The last column is the phase of the rollout that holds that use case's sites to the row: until then its setting is present and governs nothing.

| Use case | What it covers | Anchors it may reach | What paranoid adds | keyUsage | extendedKeyUsage | Specification exemption | Setting | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tls-client` | A client certificate presented to the main port, a custom listener, LDAPS or the debugger listener, and everything that reads the verdict of that handshake. On SPIFFE's gRPC sockets it holds no connection and only refuses to bind the SPIRE Server API in the clear; the channel between cells is `cell-peer`. | the client-certificate truststore, this service's own Root | The path rules on every listener, not only the main port; clientAuth and keyUsage on every leaf; revocation on every listener; a demoted connection stays demoted across TLS resumption; a failure inside the check refuses. | digitalSignature or keyAgreement | 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2 (if present) | none | `pki.paranoidTlsClient` | 1 |
| `tls-client-self-signed` | RFC 8705 self_signed_tls_client_auth, and a GNAP key proved by a pinned certificate. | the registered certificate itself | The validity window; keyUsage; the register's revocation. A self-signed leaf is accepted only here at a handshake. | digitalSignature or keyAgreement | 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2 (if present) | path: RFC 8705 section 2.2 and RFC 9635 section 7.3.2 define the method as certificate equality | `pki.paranoidTlsClientSelfSigned` | 1 |
| `tls-server-outbound` | Every address this service dials: federation back channels, SSF and GNAP push, the XACML PEP nudge, SCIM provisioning, mail, the database, the secret store, the cloud SDKs, CRL and OCSP over https, LDAPS. | the use case's own setting, the signer truststore | Revocation of the peer's certificate, stapled first, before any request body is written; serverAuth; the path rules and the host check in every process; the signer truststore beside each family's CA file. | digitalSignature or keyAgreement or keyEncipherment | 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1 (if present) | revocation: RFC 5280 section 4.2.1.13: a CRL or OCSP fetch over plain http has no certificate to check; self-signed-allowed: Not a specification, rcbj's decision: one self-signed certificate accepted by name in the signer truststore, or configured byte for byte as this dialer's own CA, still held to its window and fields | `pki.paranoidOutboundTls` | 2 |
| `jose-signer` | The x5c behind an RFC 7523 assertion, private_key_jwt, a JAR request object, a software statement or a registered JWK. | this service's own Root, the root registered with it, the signer truststore | An incomplete registered chain completed from the signer truststore before it is refused; keyUsage on the leaf; a self-signed x5c[0] in a JWK held to the upload door's rule. | digitalSignature | none asked | none | `pki.paranoidJoseSigner` | 3 |
| `saml-signer` | The certificate behind an RFC 7522 assertion, a service provider's signed request, the SOAP artifact caller and an SP metadata signature. | the root registered with it, the signer truststore, the registered certificate itself | Validity at every use; a chain to the signer truststore when the certificate is not self-signed; revocation; keyUsage; SP metadata that reaches no anchor is refused. | digitalSignature | none asked | self-signed-allowed: SAML Metadata section 2.4.1.1 lets a provider publish a self-signed certificate, when it is registered on the application | `pki.paranoidSamlSigner` | 3 |
| `federation-partner` | A partner's SAML or WS-Federation signature, a partner JWK's x5c and a federated logout signer. | the root registered with it, the signer truststore, the registered certificate itself | Validity at every use; a chain to the signer truststore when the certificate is not self-signed; revocation on logout and sign-in alike; field checks when the certificate is registered. | digitalSignature | none asked | self-signed-allowed: SAML Metadata section 2.4.1.1, when it is registered on the relationship | `pki.paranoidFederationPartner` | 3 |
| `wss-x509-token` | The WS-Security X.509 Token Profile signer of a WS-Trust request. | this service's own Root, the signer truststore | A stored outside leaf must chain to the signer truststore; the OCSP or CRL issuer comes from that path, never from the leaf's own Authority Information Access alone. | digitalSignature | none asked | none | `pki.paranoidWsSecurityToken` | 3 |
| `jose-bare-key` | OpenID Federation entity keys, SSF transmitter keys, claims-provider keys and GNAP cert keys. | the root registered with it, the signer truststore | A JWK that carries an x5c is validated as a JOSE signer; a bare JWK is left alone. | digitalSignature | none asked | path: OpenID Federation 1.1 section 3: entity keys are bare JWKs by design, when no x5c is present | `pki.paranoidJoseBareKey` | 3 |
| `encryption-recipient` | The certificate a SAML assertion is encrypted to, and a JWE recipient's x5c. | the root registered with it, the signer truststore, the registered certificate itself | Validity; keyUsage keyEncipherment or keyAgreement; revocation; nothing is ever encrypted to a certificate merely observed on a request. | keyEncipherment or keyAgreement | none asked | self-signed-allowed: SAML Metadata section 2.4.1.1, when it is registered on the application; path: RFC 7517 section 4.7 makes x5c optional, so a bare JWK has no certificate to check | `pki.paranoidEncryptionRecipient` | 4 |

| `webauthn-attestation` | A passkey's attestation statement. | the use case's own setting, the signer truststore | Each format's extendedKeyUsage and keyUsage made explicit (the TPM AIK EKU required for tpm). | `spiffe-svid` | The X509-SVID a caller of the SPIRE Server API or the Broker API presents, and a federated SVID. | the use case's own setting | The extendedKeyUsage X509-SVID section 4.3 recommends becomes required; a federated bundle's authority certificate is field-checked. | digitalSignature | 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2 or 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1 (required) | revocation: A federated SVID: the federated authority publishes nothing this service may dial | `pki.paranoidSpiffeSvid` | 5 |

| `vc-key-attestation` | The x5c of a wallet's key attestation at the credential endpoint. | the use case's own setting, the signer truststore | A real path with intermediates, not one hop; revocation where the chain names a list; keyUsage on the leaf. | digitalSignature | none asked | none | `pki.paranoidVcKeyAttestation` | 5 |
